hannah: Heads up  ran into a nasty onboarding issue with the Rust sampleapp. The UI does a whoami call to show user/org but the Rust SDK doesn't expose the admin.me endpoint. curl works fine, Rust client errors out.

mike: which route? `GET /v1/admin/me` again?

hannah: yup. curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/me` -> 200 with user JSON. Using the crate: `client.admin_me()` returns Err(NotFound) / compile-time missing binding depending on version. I grepped the generated code and there's no AdminClient generated.

sdk-bot: created issue RUST-55: missing admin.me binding in rust-sdk. https://git.redwood/dev/rust-sdk/issues/55 :white_check_mark:

ivy: oh no. The sampleapp expects a synchronous check at boot and retries the job on any error, so we see Sidekiq-like retries piling up in our job runner. In the UI the spinner never resolves.

hannah: exactly. Also found two more subtle parity problems while investigating: 1) our Rust HTTP transport canonicalizes header names to lowercase which breaks some on-prem auth plugins that are case-sensitive (they treat `authorization` different from `Authorization`) and returns 401; 2) when serializing array query params (eg user roles) the crate uses comma-joined values (`?role=admin,user`) while the REST examples and many gateways expect repeated params (`?role=admin&role=user`) and strict ingress returns 400. Together this makes onboarding flaky across customers.

mike: ouch. Can you paste the minimal repro from the sampleapp?

hannah: pasted below:

```// onboard.rs (snippet)
let client = Redwood::Client::new(&env::var("REDWOOD_TOKEN").unwrap());
let me = client.admin().me().await?; // -> Err(MissingMethod) or compile fail
open_profile(me);
```

ruth: noted. The generator currently drops tags whose name conflicts with an internal symbol (`Admin`). Quick fix: emit `admin_client()` accessor and a thin `admin()` wrapper to match ergonomic style. Also we should stop normalizing header case in the transport and add a config field `array_format: Repeat` to the query serializer.

sdk-bot: triage labels: sdk/rust, bug, onboarding, headers, query-params. Assigned to @mike.

mike: plan: 1) add compatibility shim `client.admin()` that wraps generated AdminClient; 2) update transport to preserve header casing exactly as provided by callers; 3) change array serialization default to `repeat` and add unit + integration tests; 4) add an integration test that hits `/v1/admin/me` against the staging proxy to catch header-case and query-encoding regressions.

ivy: short-term workaround for the sampleapp: call REST directly using reqwest and build the request exactly like curl: set `Authorization` case-preserved and build repeated query params. I'll add a tiny fallback in the sampleapp instantiation so onboarding won't block new users. Also adding a README note with a one-liner curl fallback.

hannah: thanks 64f. That unblocks my demo for tomorrow.

mike: ETA: patch branch today, aim to cut a patch release within 48h if CI is green. I'll post the PR and release link here.

hannah: perfect 44d. Also logging an internal follow-up to audit other SDKs for similar header/query drift so this doesn't keep recurring.
